entries.name: Vanguard
entries.earnedBy: Most switch-ins that absorbed a hit
entries.bonus: +5% Defense and Sp. Def on the turn it switches in
entries.flavor: It steps in front without thinking about it.

entries.name: Striker
entries.earnedBy: Most damage dealt across the run
entries.flavor: It saves its best for the right opening.

entries.name: Hunter
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs on targets under 50% HP
entries.flavor: It smells weakness and goes for it.

entries.name: Support
entries.earnedBy: Most status or support moves used
entries.flavor: It keeps the team in one piece.

entries.name: Anchor
entries.earnedBy: Most turns spent on the field in boss fights
entries.bonus: +5% max HP restored by held-item or move healing

entries.name: Opener
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs on the first turn of battle
entries.bonus: +5% damage on its first turn out
entries.flavor: It never wastes a first move.

entries.name: Closer
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs as the last Pokémon in the party
entries.bonus: +5% damage while it is the last party member
entries.flavor: It saves its best for last.

entries.name: Scout
entries.earnedBy: Most first-strikes against faster-looking foes
entries.bonus: +5% accuracy on its first move vs. an unseen foe
entries.flavor: It reads an opponent in a glance.

entries.name: Sweeper
entries.earnedBy: Most consecutive KOs in a single battle
entries.bonus: +5% damage after scoring a KO this battle
entries.flavor: One KO makes the next one easier.

entries.name: Wall
entries.earnedBy: Most damage absorbed without fainting

entries.name: Dodger
entries.earnedBy: Most evasions or misses forced
entries.flavor: It's never quite where you aimed.

entries.name: Medic
entries.earnedBy: Most healing given to teammates
entries.flavor: It turns every injury into a mild inconvenience.

entries.name: Pivot
entries.earnedBy: Most voluntary switches out after dealing damage
entries.bonus: After a U-turn-style move, +5% damage on the next switch-in
entries.flavor: It never stays in one place.

entries.name: Trapper
entries.earnedBy: Most uses of trapping or binding moves
entries.bonus: Trapping moves last +1 turn at most once per battle
entries.flavor: Once it holds on, it holds on.

entries.name: Disruptor
entries.earnedBy: Most opposing stat drops inflicted
entries.flavor: It knocks its foes off balance.

entries.name: Buffer
entries.earnedBy: Most own stat boosts used
entries.bonus: Stat-raising moves also restore 1/32 max HP
entries.flavor: It builds itself up before it strikes.

entries.name: Gambler
entries.earnedBy: Most uses of low-accuracy, high-reward moves

entries.name: Steady
entries.earnedBy: Most uses of moves at 100% accuracy

entries.name: Last Stander
entries.earnedBy: Most survivals at 1 HP (Sturdy, Focus Sash, Endure)

entries.name: Comeback
entries.earnedBy: Most wins from behind (fewer healthy teammates than foe)
entries.bonus: +5% damage when party has fewer alive Pokémon than foe

entries.name: Duelist
entries.earnedBy: Most 1-vs-1 wins as final Pokémon on both sides
entries.bonus: +5% damage in the last 1v1 of a battle

entries.name: Bruiser
entries.earnedBy: Most damage taken and dealt in the same battle
entries.bonus: +3% Attack and +3% Defense while at full HP

entries.name: Speedster
entries.earnedBy: Most turns in which it moved first
entries.bonus: +3% Speed on the turn after its first KO
entries.flavor: It's always gone before you blink.

entries.name: Tank Buster
entries.earnedBy: Most damage dealt to high-HP foes

entries.name: Glass Cannon
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs while taking little damage
entries.bonus: +5% damage while at full HP, −3% Defense

entries.name: Bodyguard
entries.earnedBy: Most protective moves used for allies
entries.bonus: Protection moves have +5% success chance at most once per battle
entries.flavor: It takes the hit for others.

entries.name: Pathfinder
entries.earnedBy: Most nodes cleared without a Pokémon fainting
entries.flavor: It always knows where the trail goes.

entries.name: Treasure Nose
entries.earnedBy: Most items found in the field
entries.bonus: +3% chance of an extra item from field nodes

entries.name: Berry Friend
entries.earnedBy: Most berries eaten in battle
entries.bonus: Berries it holds restore +5% more HP
entries.flavor: It never turns down a snack.

entries.name: Tidy
entries.earnedBy: Most hazards cleared or avoided

entries.name: Lucky
entries.earnedBy: Most crits landed at 1-in-24 odds or less

entries.name: Patient
entries.earnedBy: Most turns waiting before attacking
entries.bonus: +5% damage when attacking after a non-attacking turn
entries.flavor: Good things come to those who wait.

entries.name: Fire-Forged
entries.earnedBy: Most Fire-type KOs
entries.bonus: +5% damage with Fire moves while burning foe present
entries.flavor: It has been through the flames.

entries.name: Ember Heart
entries.earnedBy: Most turns at below 50% HP with a Fire move used
entries.flavor: It burns brightest when it's hurting.

entries.name: Tide Caller
entries.earnedBy: Most Water KOs in the rain
entries.flavor: It carries the weather in its pocket.

entries.name: Deep Swimmer
entries.earnedBy: Most Water-type KOs on Fire/Rock/Ground foes
entries.flavor: It knows the depth of the sea.

entries.name: Leaf Keeper
entries.earnedBy: Most healing from Grass-type drain moves

entries.name: Thorn Warden
entries.earnedBy: Most contact-penalty triggers inflicted
entries.bonus: +5% damage to foes that made contact last turn

entries.name: Storm Rider
entries.earnedBy: Most Electric KOs under rain or Electric Terrain

entries.name: Live Wire
entries.earnedBy: Most paralysis inflicted
entries.flavor: It makes everyone around it twitchy.

entries.name: Frostbound
entries.earnedBy: Most Ice KOs in snow or hail
entries.flavor: It was made for cold weather.

entries.name: Glacial Mind
entries.earnedBy: Most freeze or snowy-speed-lowering moves landed

entries.name: Iron Fist
entries.earnedBy: Most punches or kicks landed on resisted targets
entries.bonus: +5% damage vs. foes that resist its type
entries.flavor: It breaks through where others can't.

entries.name: Dojo Student
entries.earnedBy: Most use of the same Fighting move
entries.bonus: Its most-used Fighting move gains +3% accuracy

entries.name: Venom-Touched
entries.earnedBy: Most poison statuses inflicted
entries.flavor: A little goes a long way.

entries.name: Toxic Weaver
entries.earnedBy: Most Toxic or Poison Spikes uses

entries.name: Earth Shaper
entries.earnedBy: Most Ground KOs on Electric/Steel foes
entries.flavor: It knows where the weak ground is.

entries.name: Burrower
entries.earnedBy: Most turns spent underground
entries.bonus: Two-turn moves have −5% to charge chance of being interrupted

entries.name: Sky Warden
entries.earnedBy: Most Flying KOs on Fighting/Bug/Grass foes

entries.name: Windrunner
entries.earnedBy: Most turns outspeeding foes in gale or tailwind
entries.flavor: The wind is on its side.

entries.name: Mind Reader
entries.earnedBy: Most Psychic KOs on Fighting/Poison foes

entries.name: Dream Weaver
entries.earnedBy: Most sleep or confusion inflicted

entries.name: Hive Mind
entries.earnedBy: Most Bug-type KOs on Grass/Psychic/Dark foes
entries.flavor: It moves like part of something bigger.

entries.name: Silk Spinner
entries.earnedBy: Most String Shot-style moves used

entries.name: Stone Heart
entries.earnedBy: Most Rock KOs on Fire/Flying/Bug foes

entries.name: Fossil Memory
entries.earnedBy: Most survival at 1 HP
entries.flavor: Old things know how to endure.

entries.name: Night Walker
entries.earnedBy: Most Ghost KOs in night nodes

entries.name: Haunt Keeper
entries.earnedBy: Most curses or haunting moves used

entries.name: Dragon Blood
entries.earnedBy: Most Dragon KOs on boss trainers
entries.bonus: +5% Dragon damage vs. boss trainers' Pokémon

entries.name: Scale Guard
entries.earnedBy: Most hits resisted by Dragon-type scales
entries.flavor: Its scales turn aside what others take.

entries.name: Shadow Hand
entries.earnedBy: Most Dark KOs on Psychic/Ghost foes
entries.flavor: It never stands in the light if it can help it.

entries.name: Trickster
entries.earnedBy: Most use of Taunt, Torment or Fake Out
entries.flavor: It plays dirty, and likes it.

entries.name: Iron Will
entries.earnedBy: Most hits resisted by Steel typing

entries.name: Forge-Born
entries.earnedBy: Most Steel KOs on Ice/Rock/Fairy foes

entries.name: Fairy Charm
entries.earnedBy: Most Fairy KOs on Dragon/Dark/Fighting foes
entries.flavor: It wins hearts and then fights.

entries.name: Moonlit
entries.earnedBy: Most Fairy moves used at night

entries.name: Everyman
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs with plain Normal-type attacks
entries.bonus: +5% Normal damage vs. foes without resistance

entries.name: Steady Hand
entries.earnedBy: Most turns surviving at above 50% HP

entries.name: Rain Dancer
entries.earnedBy: Most weather set per run
entries.bonus: Weather it sets lasts +1 turn at most once per battle
entries.flavor: It brings the sky with it.

entries.name: Terrain Master
entries.earnedBy: Most terrain set per run
entries.bonus: Terrain lasts +1 turn at most once per battle

entries.name: Trick Roomer
entries.earnedBy: Most Trick Room or Room-style moves used
entries.bonus: Room moves last +1 turn at most once per battle
entries.flavor: It plays with the order of things.

entries.name: Hazard Setter
entries.earnedBy: Most hazards set
entries.bonus: Hazards set deal +1/32 max HP extra
entries.flavor: It decorates the field with unfriendly things.

entries.name: Cleaner
entries.earnedBy: Most hazards or screens removed
entries.bonus: Removal moves also restore 1/16 max HP
entries.flavor: It tidies up and feels good about it.

entries.name: Screen Keeper
entries.earnedBy: Most Reflect/Light Screen uses

entries.name: Scarfer
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs while outspeeding with a Choice item

entries.name: Lead-Out
entries.earnedBy: Most battles started as the lead
entries.bonus: +5% damage in the first two turns of a battle

entries.earnedBy: Highest bond score on the team
entries.bonus: Bond bonus (§2) +2 on top of its own
entries.flavor: It wants nothing more than to be with you.

entries.name: Rival Breaker
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs on rival's Pokémon

entries.name: Gym Slayer
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs in Gym battles
entries.flavor: Gym leaders dread to see it.

entries.name: Elite Slayer
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs in Elite Four battles
entries.flavor: It performs when the stakes are highest.

entries.name: Champion Slayer
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs on Champion's team

entries.name: Legend Hunter
entries.earnedBy: Most damage dealt to Legendary encounters

entries.name: Shiny Glint
entries.earnedBy: Shiny Pokémon with 10+ battles
entries.flavor: It just has a certain spark.

entries.name: Elder
entries.earnedBy: Longest-surviving Pokémon in the run
entries.bonus: +3% XP gain for others on the team
entries.flavor: It remembers how things were done.

entries.name: Prodigy
entries.earnedBy: Fastest to reach level 30 on its team
entries.flavor: It learns faster than it should.

entries.name: Late Bloomer
entries.earnedBy: Latest evolution on the team

entries.name: Free Spirit
entries.earnedBy: Most nodes where it wandered off
entries.bonus: +3% encounter rate of rare wild Pokémon

entries.name: Night Owl
entries.earnedBy: Most battle wins at night

entries.name: Sunbather
entries.earnedBy: Most battle wins in daytime

entries.name: Storm Chaser
entries.earnedBy: Most battles fought under changing weather

entries.name: Shield Sibling

entries.bonus: +3% damage when its best friend is alive

entries.name: Rival Mirror
entries.earnedBy: Most battles vs. same-type opponents

entries.name: Loner

entries.name: Cheerleader
entries.earnedBy: Most morale boosts given
entries.bonus: Team morale gain +1 once per battle

entries.earnedBy: Most move masteries on the team

entries.earnedBy: Most move tutor / TM moves learned
entries.bonus: +1 free move slot preview in rest nodes
entries.flavor: It knows a bit of everything.

entries.name: Egg Warm
entries.earnedBy: Most eggs hatched in party
entries.flavor: The eggs love being near it.

entries.name: Frontline Pet
entries.earnedBy: Most town visits with the player
entries.bonus: Shops give an extra 3% discount at most once per run

entries.name: Chorus Lead
entries.earnedBy: Most sound-based moves used
entries.flavor: It sets the key for everyone.

entries.name: Tricky Feet
entries.earnedBy: Most moves dodged via Protect/Detect
entries.bonus: Protect-style moves +3% success chance (once per battle)

entries.name: Weather-Wise
entries.earnedBy: Most battles in non-clear weather

entries.name: Bond Breaker
entries.earnedBy: Most KOs on foes at full HP
entries.bonus: +5% damage vs. foes at full HP

entries.earnedBy: Most turns spent without being targeted
entries.bonus: +3% damage after a turn where it was not targeted
